title: Vercel opens Schedules beta and adds Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
summary: Vercel’s new scheduler runs one-time and recurring tasks in preview and production. AI Gateway adds a Google model that generates short videos with audio.
imageAlt: A calendar with a clock sits beside a video player with an audio waveform
imageCaption: Original illustration of scheduled web jobs and generated video.

sections.heading: Vercel Schedules brings timed jobs to preview environments
paragraphs: On November 5, Vercel opened Schedules to all plans in public beta. It can run a job once or on a recurring schedule, with support for preview, production, and custom environments. Schedules declared in vercel.json can target a private function, an HTTP path, or a queue topic. A schedule created at runtime targets a queue topic.

For a website that refreshes a catalog on a timer, running the job on demand in preview makes it possible to check the data and page behavior before enabling the production schedule. Vercel says existing Cron Jobs continue to work.

sections.heading: Gemini Omni returns a finished video file through AI Gateway
paragraphs: In a separate November 5 announcement, Vercel added Google’s Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash to AI Gateway. It generates clips of 3 to 15 seconds with audio and can edit source clips with up to six reference images. The AI SDK integration returns the video as a complete file, including when the application uses streamText.

A web editor can show a pending state while generation runs and offer playback once the file arrives. For an interface that lets users refine a clip, keep the previous result visible until its replacement is ready so they can compare the two.

zh-TW.title: Vercel Schedules 開放公測，AI Gateway 加入 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
zh-TW.summary: Vercel 的新排程服務可在預覽與正式環境執行單次或週期性任務。AI Gateway 也加入 Google 的模型，可生成帶有聲音的短片。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 帶有時鐘的日曆，旁邊是顯示音訊波形的影片播放器
zh-TW.imageCaption: 描繪網站排程與影片生成的原創插畫。

sections.heading: Vercel Schedules 可在預覽環境執行定時任務
paragraphs: Vercel 於 11 月 5 日向所有方案開放 Schedules 公測。排程可以執行一次，也能定期執行，並支援預覽、正式與自訂環境。在 vercel.json 宣告的排程可呼叫私有函式、HTTP 路徑，或將訊息送到佇列主題。程式在執行期間建立的排程則以佇列主題為目標。
以定時更新商品目錄的網站為例，團隊可以先在預覽環境手動觸發排程，確認資料與頁面顯示是否符合預期，再啟用正式環境的排程。Vercel 表示，既有的 Cron Jobs 仍可繼續使用。

sections.heading: Gemini Omni 透過 AI Gateway 回傳完整影片
paragraphs: Vercel 在 11 月 5 日的另一則公告中，將 Google 的 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 加入 AI Gateway。它可生成 3 至 15 秒的有聲影片，也可搭配最多六張參考圖片編修來源影片。即使用 AI SDK 的 streamText，影片仍會以完整檔案回傳。
網頁編輯器可在生成期間顯示等待狀態，等檔案到達後再提供播放。如果介面允許使用者反覆調整影片，可以保留上一個版本，待新版本完成後讓使用者比較。
